nodes.name: Lead In (from Clay)
nodes.notes: Clay HTTP API / webhook pushes one enriched, email-verified lead row per call. Skip rows that failed email verification in Clay — never send to unverified addresses.

nodes.name: Score Lead (Claude Haiku)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5', max_tokens: 1024, system: $vars.PROMPT_LEAD_SCORING, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: '<icp_rubric>' + $vars.CLIENT_ICP_RUBRIC + '</icp_rubric>\n<lead_record>' + JSON.stringify($json.body) + '</lead_record>\nScore this lead against the rubric. Respond only with JSON.' }], output_config: { format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: $vars.SCHEMA_LEAD_SCORE } } }) }}

nodes.notes: Prompt: prompts/01-lead-scoring.md. Schema: schemas/lead-score.schema.json (store both in n8n Variables or load from repo). Structured outputs guarantee the response shape.

nodes.name: Gate: score >= 60 & not disqualified
nodes.notes: False branch → Save Rejected Lead. Filtering BEFORE further enrichment/research keeps Clay credit + token spend on qualified leads only.

nodes.name: Save Rejected Lead
nodes.notes: status='rejected', persist score + reasoning for the audit trail.

nodes.name: Research Hook (Claygent or fetch+Claude)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 2048, system: $vars.PROMPT_RESEARCH_HOOK, tools: [{ type: 'web_fetch_20260209', name: 'web_fetch' }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Company: ' + $json.company_name + ' — ' + $json.website_url }], output_config: { format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: $vars.SCHEMA_RESEARCH_HOOK } } }) }}

nodes.notes: If using Claygent for this step instead, run it in Clay before the webhook and pass the hook JSON through. Prompt: prompts/02-research-hook.md.

nodes.name: Retrieve Client KB (Supabase kb_search)
nodes.notes: Call the kb_search() hybrid-retrieval function (RPC) with the lead's segment/topic to pull offer, voice rules, segment opener, and few-shot example emails.

nodes.name: Draft Email (Claude Sonnet — writer)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 1024, system: [{ type: 'text', text: $vars.PROMPT_EMAIL_DRAFT, cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: '<verified_fields>' + JSON.stringify($json.lead) + JSON.stringify($json.hook) + '</verified_fields>\n<client_knowledge>' + $json.kb_chunks + '</client_knowledge>\nWrite the email. Respond only with JSON.' }], output_config: { format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: $vars.SCHEMA_EMAIL_DRAFT } } }) }}

nodes.notes: Prompt: prompts/03-email-draft.md. System prompt + KB are stable per client — cache_control keeps cached input at ~10% price.

nodes.name: Reviewer Judge (Claude Opus)

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-4-8', max_tokens: 2048, system: $vars.PROMPT_REVIEWER_JUDGE, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: '<source_data>' + JSON.stringify($json.source) + '</source_data>
<banned_claims>' + $vars.CLIENT_BANNED_CLAIMS + '</banned_claims>
<voice_rules>' + $vars.CLIENT_VOICE_RULES + '</voice_rules>
<draft>' + JSON.stringify($json.draft) + '</draft>
Review this draft. Respond only with JSON.' }], output_config: { format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: $vars.SCHEMA_REVIEWER_VERDICT } } }) }}

nodes.notes: Prompt: prompts/04-reviewer-judge.md. A DIFFERENT model than the writer, on purpose. Routing: pass+conf>0.9 proceed; 0.6-0.9 proceed+flag; fail/<0.6 block. Revision loop (verdict='revise' → back to Draft Email with revision_instructions) capped at 2.

nodes.name: Gate: verdict
nodes.notes: revise → back to Draft Email (cap retries at 2 via a counter on the item); fail → human escalation queue.

nodes.name: Human Approval Gate (Wait)
nodes.notes: MANDATORY while approval_mode='all'. Post the draft + verdict to Slack with Approve/Edit/Reject buttons that hit this node's resume webhook. Operator edits are saved to drafts.edited_body — they become the eval set. Move to sampling only when judge false-pass rate ≈ 0 on the planted-hallucination set AND manual edit rate < 10-20%.

nodes.name: Push to Sequencer (Instantly)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ campaign: $vars.INSTANTLY_CAMPAIGN_ID, email: $json.lead.email, first_name: $json.lead.contact_name, custom_variables: { subject: $json.draft.subject, body: $json.approved_body } }) }}

nodes.notes: Smartlead for multi-client/agency workspaces. The sequencer appends the unsubscribe link + postal address (CAN-SPAM) and handles follow-up touches, warmed inboxes, 30-50 emails/inbox/day.

nodes.name: Log Event (Supabase)
nodes.notes: event_type='sent'. Every step in this chain should also log its event (scored, hook_found, drafted, judge_pass/fail, approved) — omitted here for skeleton brevity.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5', max_tokens: 1024, system: $vars.PROMPT_REPLY_CLASSIFICATION, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: '<outbound_thread>' + JSON.stringify($json.body.thread) + '</outbound_thread>\n<inbound_reply>' + $json.body.reply_body + '</inbound_reply>\nClassify this reply. Respond only with JSON.' }], output_config: { format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: $vars.SCHEMA_REPLY_INTENT } } }) }}

nodes.name: Route by Intent
nodes.notes: Full routing table in the README: interested → notify operator + Cal.com link (<2h SLA); referral → new lead (<24h); objection/info_request → typed nurture (<4h); out_of_office → pause + resume date; fallback output handles not_interested / meeting_booked / referral branches (add nodes per action).

nodes.name: Suppress Immediately
nodes.notes: CAN-SPAM: suppression is fully automated and immediate — it never waits for a human. Also call the sequencer's suppression/blocklist API in this branch so every inbox stops at once.

nodes.name: Notify Operator (Slack)
nodes.notes: interested → share Cal.com link, set CRM stage 'engaged', SLA < 2h. On meeting_booked: write meeting + full thread context to CRM.
